author: _iMan
body:
Hi guys! I'm back to introduce my first DTM map.

I built this map along with {tag=68cfe240d81c46ae8a939e3eb5d71e3e} and some help from {tag=32f9750efe564f7aaa981573efdc4dc2}.


Information:

 Team colours: Blue v Red
 Team sizes: 20 v 20
4 monuments; there is one on either side on there own islands at the back, at the back but in the middle there are the 2 other monuments, on the same island.
 Starter kit: Leather chestplate and leggings, chainmail helmet and boots, 2 gapples, 32 arrows, infinite 1 bow, 64 glass, 64 wood planks, stone sword, 32 steaks.

Picture Album: http://imgur.com/a/Uiupi

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
We regret to inform you that your map will not be added. We have declined it for the following reasons:

- The islands need more shape and are too similar to other islands, the islands are flat and don't have much on them either.
- Needs better block variation.
- The middle is too hard to push
- The middle is a massive choke point and once getting past you have to go past spawn and run on a flat island
- Needs new front lines.
- The amount of variation in wool colouring is too much- it makes it hard on the eyes to look at for long periods of time.

If changes are made, you may repost your map with the requests above, and reply to this comment. We will then reevaluate it for further action on whether or not it will be accepted.

Thank you very much for submitting!
